visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are positioned in a brightly lit studio with pastel pink and blue backdrops. A-ben, with light pink hair and wearing black overalls over a white tee, sits at a desk holding a 'Check List' card. Kuan Kuan sits next to him in a denim shirt. A third man in a green shirt stands to the left. (2) A-ben performs micro-actions of pointing and wide-eyed expressions while speaking. His hands move frequently in a rhythmic fashion. Kuan Kuan reacts by leaning away and laughing. The lighting is uniform and bright across the entire set. (3) The scene cuts to a wider angle showing a female audience seated on tiered benches in the background. Insets of on-screen text in bright red and yellow bubble fonts appear around the characters. A-ben continues to gesture towards his board. (4) A jump cut shows host Dee Hsu in a dark dress and a young man in an olive green t-shirt. Dee's eyes are wide, showing a shocked reaction. Yellow variety-show captions appear at the bottom and top of the frame. (5) Kuan Kuan is shown in a close-up, laughing so hard his shoulders shake and he covers his face. A-ben points at him accusingly. The visual rhythm is fast, driven by multiple shots of different people's reactions within the studio environment.
